old_findings.note: The P1 factoring is gone: the guard reads uint64(stor[0xf0c57e16...6a00]), visibly the slot of storF0C5 (330-331). _initialized is still split into storF0C5 (uint8) + storF0C5_8 (uint56) and read raw.

regressions.issue: The Teleporter sendCrossChainMessage call loses its selector name and decoded arguments and becomes a raw memory call (P2) at 4 of its 6 sites. The pointer read _76 = mem[64] before the allowedRelayerAddresses copy loop is no longer identified with mem[64] after that loop, so '_76 - mem[64]' remains in every address. The loop stores nothing to mem[64].
regressions.rule: A loop whose body never stores to mem[64] leaves mem[64] equal to its value at loop entry: after the loop, use that exact value (here _76), not only a constant floor. The same rule fixes c00040's acceptNewTerms.
regressions.verified: reading only (new 641-668: no mem[64] store inside the while)

regressions.issue: The decoded message struct is now addressed by the full pointer sum at every field use, where the old text had a base _30 and locals (_50 amount, _56/_57 addresses). The amount alone appears about 10 times as a 4-term memory address, in conditions, logs and call values. Exact, but much harder to read.
regressions.rule: Bind a struct allocated at the free-memory pointer to one variable at its allocation (_p = mem[64] before the bump) and print fields as mem[_p + k], keeping single-use loads as named locals.

new_findings.issue: The approve(spender, 0) call is now named (it was raw memory), but the spender word prints as a 28-byte slice plus a 4-byte slice, the halves of the memcpy that builds the call data. Its write mem[_46 + 36 len 28] is also printed though unused.
new_findings.rule: Merge adjacent pieces of one source word: Bytes(28, uint128(x >> 32)) followed by Bytes(4, uint32(x)) is x (here address(_5)).

improvements: P1 fixed (the Initializable slot prints whole). P6 9 -> 0 (address constants print 40 hex digits). Revert strings decoded: 'SafeERC20TransferFrom: balance not increased', 'TeleporterRegistryApp: Teleporter sending paused', 'TeleporterRegistryApp: zero fee token address'. transferFrom, allowance and approve are named, and receiveTeleporterMessage's user call is decoded (unknown2c3625fe with value and gas). send's enum check 'mem[_N] >= 5 -> Panic(33)' is dropped, correctly: the encoded value is the constant 3. A pointer bump is folded (mem[64] = _33 + 256). Raw-memory calls 23 -> 13.
notes: Diff of 1,492 lines, read hunk by hunk. Calls, logs and storage writes are unchanged in number in all changed functions. send's 2 fewer reverts are the constant-folded Panic(33) checks. Both regressions share the cause in c00040: the free-memory pointer is not kept exact across a loop or join that does not store it. The 2 Teleporter calls in send were already raw in round 1.
summary: Many calls and revert strings are now decoded and P1/P6 are fixed. But 4 of the 6 Teleporter sendCrossChainMessage calls lose their decoded arguments (medium), and receiveTeleporterMessage's struct fields lose their locals (low).
